facts.fact: UNESCO states that public actors, technical and financial partners and experts met in Kinshasa on 4 August 2026 and validated the Politique sectorielle de l'économie numérique (PSEN), which with the AI strategy will set the country's orientations to 2030, at the end of a process led by the government through the digital economy ministry.
UNESCO reports the PSEN was validated on 4 August 2026, giving the DRC a strategic framework to 2030.

systems.tiers: national; validated 4 August 2026; built with UNESCO's AI readiness assessment
